positions.name: ErasureDirectiveScope
positions.frame: what does it mean to issue an imperative erasure order across escalating specificity?
positions.why: Both expressions perform the same directive act — an imperative command to discard knowledge — with shared directional reads across affect (activated-negative urgency), relational (authority-ranking), power (pressure), value (autonomy), and conviction (decision, not claim). src-1 opens with a bare 'Forget' command; src-2 escalates by enumerating the triadic scope of removal (instrument, measurement, person). The frame holds the shared erasure-directive stance while tracking the escalation from general to specific.
